title: Figures 2-3: Lockheed SR-71 Blackbird and F-117 Nighthawk stealth fighter
description: Two aircraft images: "Figure 2. Lockheed Martin Skunk Works SR-71 Black Bird," a rear view of the SR-71 with afterburners lit above clouds, credited as a Jim Hatch illustration, and "Figure 3. Lockheed F-117 Nighthawk Stealth Fighter," an in-flight photo of the faceted black jet over desert terrain. The text notes some black triangle and saucer-shaped UAP reports may be explained by sightings of advanced aircraft, while cylindrical, spherical and ellipsoid UAPs that hover and accelerate are harder to explain. Page 22 of the BAASS UAP Analysis Capabilities summary report, November 23, 2010.
